title: Agent tracking for decade-aware agents
body:
decade has no agent model. A socket client can send `status` with a state and a message. The state lives on `channel::Client` with a `since` time, and it goes away when the connection drops. Nothing records who the agent is, its session, model or usage, or its history, so the chrome shows a state with no agent behind it. Jack wants a proper agent tracking layer for decade-aware agents, over `decade-channel`. coax will adopt it in its own repository.

The pieces, in order:

- the protocol and the `decade-channel` API: an agent identity in hello, merged agent updates, and an `ended` message
- the model in `src/server/agents.rs`: agents keyed by session per workspace, kept in memory across reconnects, dropped on `ended` or after 10 minutes disconnected
- the UI: cards, the rail popover and tab pills drawn from the model

Agents live in memory only. They do not survive a server restart.
close_reason: All children are closed. The protocol (896d419), the model (f025309), the chrome (155cd62) and the usage-line fix are on `dev`.
